subject: Request: Keep pilot environment active while PO clears

From: Patrick Mulligan <patrick@blueoakhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement is delayed, can we keep the sandbox live?

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from procurement: our PO that covers the pilot is still routing through finance/legal and won’t land this week as we hoped. The engineering team is mid-run with Redwood and losing access would stall our eval momentum.

Is there a short-term option to keep our sandbox active (or provide a small credit voucher) until the PO clears? We anticipate the PO to be signed by 7/22 but I can push for an earlier date. The pilot is under deal BOH-2026-034.

Appreciate any help — we’re excited about the performance but don’t want to lose the dev team’s momentum.

— Patrick

Hi Patrick — thanks for the heads up and for the timeline. We can usually accommodate short delays with a temporary credit while the PO finishes routing. I’ll loop in Ben and Karthik for quick approval.

Can you reply with the expected PO date and, if possible, a copy or placeholder of the PO (even a one-line confirmation) so we have something on file? That speeds approvals on our side.

I’ve cc’d Ben (sales lead) and Karthik (billing approvals). I’m proposing a 7-day sandbox credit or a $750 credit as a bridge — happy to adjust based on approvals.

Thanks —
Soojin

Soojin — thanks for flagging. I’m comfortable approving a small bridging credit to preserve momentum. Recommendations:
- Apply a $600 pilot credit to BlueOak Health account (deal BOH-2026-034).
- Credit valid for 14 days; if PO arrives earlier we’ll reconcile and convert to usage billing.
- Require a PO expected date and contact in procurement (Patrick provided).

Marissa, please note for renewal/expansion follow-up in two weeks and capture in the renewal playbook if they convert.
